hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: OUTBOUND_EMAIL_USER
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: The user account of an smtp service (default gmail) to use for sending mail

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: EMAIL_FROM
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: The name that should be displayed as the outbound account. If not supplied, this is the same as the email address provided.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: OUTBOUND_EMAIL_USER_PASSWORD
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Password for the gmail account used to send mail

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
export oldpassword=`grep '^EMAIL_PASSWORD=' /usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env | cut -d '=' -f 2-` export olduser=`grep '^EMAIL_ADDRESS=' /usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env | cut -d '=' -f 2-` export oldfrom=`grep '^USER_ACTIVATION_REPLY_TO=' /usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env | cut -d '=' -f 2-`
if [ -n "$OUTBOUND_EMAIL_USER_PASSWORD" ] && [ -n "$oldpassword" ] ; then sed -i "s/$oldpassword/$OUTBOUND_EMAIL_USER_PASSWORD/g" /usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env fi if [ -n "$OUTBOUND_EMAIL_USER" ] && [ -n "$olduser" ] ; then sed -i "s/$olduser/$OUTBOUND_EMAIL_USER/g" /usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env fi if [ -n "$EMAIL_FROM" ] && [ -n "$oldfrom" ] ; then sed -i "s/$oldfrom/$EMAIL_FROM/g" /usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env fi
